meta.name: gstack-careful
meta.description: GStack careful mode for risky work that needs a conservative pass, hazards, safeguards, and explicit confirmation points before execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为高风险操作添加安全确认步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在执行危险命令前强制确认
copy.tagline_en: Add safety confirmation steps for risky operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need forced confirmation before executing risky commands

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先分析风险（如破坏数据、生产环境等），列出危害、安全措施、只读检查、确认点，然后给出安全的下一步操作。默认只读，直到你确认。
howto.when: 当你即将执行可能破坏数据、生产环境或认证状态的操作，或明确要求“小心点”，或说出“$gstack-careful”时触发。

say.text: 帮我小心地删除这个数据库表。
say.note: Claude 会先列出风险和安全措施，等你确认。

say.text: 我要修改生产环境的配置，请小心处理。
say.note: Claude 会分析危害并给出确认点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first analyze risks (e.g., breaking data, production, auth), list hazards, safeguards, read-only checks, confirmation points, then suggest a safe next action. Defaults to read-only until you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are about to perform an action that could break data, production, auth, or release state, or when you explicitly ask to be careful, or say "$gstack-careful".

say_en.text: Help me carefully delete this database table.
say_en.note: Claude will list risks and safeguards, then wait for your confirmation.

say_en.text: I need to modify production config, please be careful.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze hazards and provide confirmation points.
